title: Wild Mushroom Fajitas
description: A classic Mexican dish made with sautéed wild mushrooms and served with saudia flatbread.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chopped onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add the wild mushrooms and stir-fry for 4-5 minutes until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the pan and stir-fry for another minute.
Warm the saudia flatbread by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the fajitas by placing the sautéed mushrooms onto the flatbread and serving hot.
